WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
), account_differences AS (
    SELECT
        oc.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        oc.order_count,
        oc.order_count - AVG(oc.order_count) OVER () AS difference
    FROM order_counts AS oc
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
)
SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference
FROM account_differences
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
